description: the tray strip window: events (core:default) plus opening http(s) links in the system browser: the SpecterComs website for 'Create account', and links in a server's welcome panel (web-portal/src/utils/openExternal.js; the renderer, utils/safeMarkdown.js, only ever produces absolute http/https URLs). No other scheme (file:, mailto:, custom protocols) and no opener:allow-open-path. Showing, hiding, positioning and clipping the strip are done from Rust (strip.rs commands), so no window permissions are granted here.
